2},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022HumanGate\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RefinementSessionId\u0022:null,\u0022FeedbackStep\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"d142e493-9959-46ac-9ab6-bd6baac85957","originSequence":222138,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-19T14:28:32.53541+00:00","originProjectId":"01a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb"},{"streamId":"01a1f435-13e7-7144-8e75-b30e9d2d95bb","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.DraftRefinementDispatched","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1f435-13e7-7144-8e75-b30e9d2d95bb\u0022,\u0022SessionId\u0022:\u002201a1f435-9570-7271-9177-07f1ae324ce3\u0022,\u0022NodeId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4\u0022,\u0022DispatchedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-19T14:28:34.871498\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022Model\u0022:\u0022claude-opus-5-5[1m]\u0022,\u0022Effort\u0022:\u0022high\u0022,\u0022Purpose\u0022:\u0022Refine\u0022}","originEventId":"e07c6f01-8a02-4371-be2c-593f8ee4ab42","originSequence":222140,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-19T14:28:34.872145+00:00","originProjectId":"01a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb"},{"streamId":"01a1f435-13e7-7144-8e75-b30e9d2d95bb","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1f435-13e7-7144-8e75-b30e9d2d95bb\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022For every session, confined or not, the tool guard judges the path of a Read, Edit, Write, Glob, or Grep call as the Claude Code CLI will open it, so a \\u0060$NAME\\u0060 or \\u0060${NAME}\\u0060 written into that path can no longer make the guard decide on a different place than the one the call reaches.\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022In a session that is not confined, a Read, Edit, or Write whose file path holds \\u0060$NAME\\u0060 or \\u0060${NAME}\\u0060, and a Glob or Grep whose path or pattern holds one, is refused whenever the path read as the CLI opens it (a leading \\u0060~\\u0060 or \\u0060~/\\u0060 taken as the home directory, no variable substituted, and \\u0060.\\u0060 and \\u0060..\\u0060 collapsed) is in, or contains, the node home or a protected Claude Code config directory, even when the path with its variables substituted lies inside the work directory. New tests in \\u0060tests/Coanda.Tests/Daemon/Executors/ToolGuardTests.cs\\u0060 show this for each of Read, Edit, Write, Grep\\u0027s path, and Glob\\u0027s pattern and path, against the node home and against a config directory.\u0022,\u0022A confined session gets the same refusals as the first criterion, decided by the same reading of the path rather than by a second one written for confined sessions only, and a new test shows one such call refused in a confined session.\u0022,\u0022Every test in \\u0060ToolGuardTests.cs\\u0060 and \\u0060ConfinedSessionTests.cs\\u0060 that exists on \\u0060main\\u0060 when the work starts passes without being edited, so no call the guard refuses today becomes allowed. In particular, a Bash command\\u0027s words are still judged after \\u0060~\\u0060 and variable expansion as a shell expands them, and a file tool\\u0027s path naming \\u0060~NAME\\u0060 is still refused.\u0022,\u0022The paragraph of \\u0060docs/node-configuration.md\\u0060 that lists which paths the guard reads, and the remarks on the \\u0060ToolGuard\\u0060 class, say that a file tool\\u0027s path is judged as the CLI opens it, naming the CLI version whose path handling was confirmed, and that variable expansion applies only to a Bash command\\u0027s words.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022## What is wrong\\n\\nThe tool guard (\\u0060src/Coanda.Daemon/Executors/ClaudeCode/ToolGuard.cs\\u0060) builds the path it judges for\\na Read, Edit, or Write, and for a Grep\\u0027s path, with \\u0060Expanded\\u0060, which is \\u0060ShellWords.Expand\\u0060\\n(\\u0060ShellWords.cs:576\\u0060): it substitutes every \\u0060$NAME\\u0060 and \\u0060${NAME}\\u0060, with \\u0060$PWD\\u0060 taken as the call\\u0027s\\ndirectory. A Glob\\u0027s pattern and path go through the same expansion in the local \\u0060Glob\\u0060 function. At\\ncommit 8a6f96ac these are lines 119 to 127 and 194 to 208. (The routed finding cites line 129, which\\nis the Bash arm; the defect is in the arms above it.)\\n\\nThe Claude Code CLI does not substitute variables in these tools\\u0027 paths. As far as the review that\\nfound this could tell from the 2.1.328 binary, it expands only a leading \\u0060~\\u0060 or \\u0060~/\\u0060, then collapses\\n\\u0060.\\u0060 and \\u0060..\\u0060 by text before it opens the file. Because a substituted variable can change how many\\ncomponents the path has, the guard can judge one directory while the CLI opens another. That is\\ntrue for an unconfined session on \\u0060main\\u0060 today, and for a confined session too.\\n\\nBash is different and stays as it is: the shell does expand its words, so the guard is right to.\\n\\n## Why this is blocked by the confinement task\\n\\nThe confinement task (01a1f0ea) found the same mismatch for confined sessions and is fixing it in\\nits own pull request, which edits the same lines of \\u0060ToolGuard.cs\\u0060. Its fix may cover only confined\\nsessions. This task starts from \\u0060main\\u0060 after that pull request merges and makes the guard use one\\nreading of a file tool\\u0027s path for every session: if the merged fix already does that for all\\nsessions, this task adds the unconfined tests and docs and nothing else; if it is conditioned on\\nconfinement, this task drops the condition. It is blocked rather than stacked because it needs\\nnothing from that branch before merge; waiting only avoids a second, conflicting edit of the same\\nlines.\\n\\n## Hints, not requirements\\n\\n- The guard already judges a Bash word both as written and with its backslashes removed, refusing\\n  when either reading reaches a protected directory (\\u0060Unescaped\\u0060 in \\u0060ToolGuard.cs\\u0060). Judging a file\\n  tool\\u0027s path both as the CLI reads it and as it is expanded today is the smallest change that also\\n  keeps every current refusal, including the \\u0060~NAME\\u0060 one, which the third criterion requires.\\n- Confirm the CLI\\u0027s path handling against the installed CLI before relying on it, and name that\\n  version in the docs (fourth criterion).\\n\\n## Non-goals\\n\\n- The guard resolves a link before it applies a later \\u0060..\\u0060, while the CLI collapses \\u0060..\\u0060 by text\\n  first. The same review noted that mismatch separately; it is not this task\\u0027s.\\n- No change to how Bash commands are read, to which tools are guarded, or to what a confined\\n  session may reach.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u002201a1f0ea-ad69-7438-acb5-4247e4fb1fd3\u0022]},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-19T14:31:54.502969\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022HumanGate\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RefinementSessionId\u0022:\u002201a1f435-9570-7271-9177-07f1ae324ce3\u0022,\u0022FeedbackStep\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"e3143f23-1238-4d2c-bcc0-12a5c4d8a8be","originSequence":222156,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-19T14:31:54.515716+00:00","originProjectId":"01a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb"},{"streamId":"01a1f435-13e7-7144-8e75-b30e9d2d95bb","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.PublicationTokensRecorded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1f435-13e7-7144-8e75-b30e9d2d95bb\u0022,\u0022InputTokens\u0022:38,\u0022OutputTokens\u0022:15173,\u0022CostUsd\u0022:1.0454070000000002,\u0022RecordedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-19T14:31:55.711779\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022CacheReadInputTokens\u0022:11
